image_description: A close-up photograph of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a thin, woody branch. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, and a white belly. The upperparts are dark brown/black with distinct white shoulder patches and wing bars. The bill is conical, pale yellow/ivory with a dark tip. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige/brown.
